TypeScript, JavaScript, Java (Android), React Native / Expo, Fastify / Node.js, HTML, CSS, SQL / PostgreSQL; Git and GitHub; AI-assisted software development

bullets: Provided day-to-day technical assistance to employees with desktop and laptop software issues.
